text:
SyncLayer is a fast-growing analytics startup helping mid-market retailers optimize inventory and pricing through real-time data products. We’re a small, cross-functional team moving fast — if you like turning messy data into clear decisions and shipping dashboards that people actually use, come build with us.

What you'll do
- Collaborate with product, sales and operations to define analytics needs and translate business questions into measurable metrics.
- Extract, clean and analyze datasets to identify trends, anomalies and opportunities.
- Build and maintain dashboards and visualizations for stakeholders using Tableau.
- Produce repeatable SQL queries and Excel models to support ad-hoc analysis and reporting.
- Use pandas to transform data and create reproducible analysis pipelines.
- Present findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders; support decision-making with clear visualizations and narratives.
- Help define requirements for data collection and improvements to upstream data quality.

What we need (mandatory)
- SQL
- Microsoft Excel
- pandas
- Tableau
- 1-3 years experience working in analytics, business intelligence or a related role

Bonus points (preferred/good-to-have)
- Statistics
- Python
- Power BI
- Looker

Location and work mode
Hybrid: Pune or Delhi NCR, 3 days a week in the office.
